summary: Regional HR Manager with about 5.5 years of HR experience across recruitment, employee relations and performance management, primarily in the banking sector. Has managed end-to-end hiring cycles, including mass recruitment drives and campus hiring, and led a small HR team covering multiple states. Experienced in performance management cycles, HRIS maintenance, payroll onboarding, investigations and attrition and recruitment forecasting, with reporting to business and regional heads.
